assets.name: Cooperative Crown Baseline
assets.controlledVariable: none; production-clean restatement of the round-one winner
assets.thesis: A quieter, production-clean Cooperative Crown establishes the visual control for this batch.
assets.businessCue: A retailer-owned cooperative organized around shared infrastructure.

assets.name: Crown Beacon
assets.thesis: A taller shared beacon tests whether a stronger capital-city skyline improves the crown without changing its plan.
assets.businessCue: Shared cooperative guidance made visible as a central civic landmark.

assets.name: Civic Arcade Crown
assets.thesis: A stronger civic arcade tests whether a more legible public threshold makes the capital feel welcoming and important.
assets.businessCue: Neighborhood access and helpful service expressed through an open civic face.

assets.name: Open Workshop Commons
assets.controlledVariable: wing openness and visible work bays
assets.thesis: Open truss bays test whether visible making and repair activity should replace the control's enclosed wings.
assets.businessCue: Practical expertise, repair, and making visible without literal product signage.

assets.name: Compact Cooperative
assets.thesis: A tighter footprint tests whether the same cooperative hierarchy reads more clearly with less campus sprawl.
assets.businessCue: Many locally owned stores coordinated through a compact shared center.

assets.name: Material Assembly Crown
assets.thesis: More explicit timber, steel, and masonry assembly tests whether construction intelligence should define the capital's identity.
assets.businessCue: Tools, building materials, fasteners, and practical construction knowledge.

assets.name: Repair Exchange Crown
assets.thesis: A legible repair exchange tests whether service activity can carry the ACE identity while retaining the crown plan.
assets.businessCue: Repair, maintenance, helpful expertise, and neighborhood service.

assets.name: Neighborhood Service Forum
assets.thesis: A public forum combines the arcade and open-workshop hypotheses into a neighborhood-facing civic capital.
assets.businessCue: Locally owned stores, practical help, and visible community service.

assets.name: Connected Supply Crown
assets.thesis: A compact connected crown tests whether cooperative distribution can read as underlying infrastructure rather than a sprawling campus.
assets.businessCue: Shared supply and distribution supporting independently owned neighborhood stores.

assets.name: Cooperative Crown Synthesis
assets.controlledVariable: height, civic entry, open service wings, and structural expression
assets.thesis: The synthesis combines the batch's strongest plausible capital cues while preserving Cooperative Crown as the governing idea.
assets.businessCue: Cooperative ownership, local service, tools, repair, materials, and shared infrastructure.
